name: Herb Search — free-text query returns herb cards

planSteps.description: A heading 'Welcome to the Herbary' is visible and the 'Consult the Archive' button is disabled
Type 'trouble sleeping' into the search input and click 'Consult the Archive'
Wait for the loading indicator to disappear
A tab button with text matching 'Herbs (N)' where N is greater than 0 is visible and active
At least one herb card is shown, each with a herb name heading, a '% match' badge and a description paragraph
